_comment: Explicit exceptions to the i18n guard (scripts/check-i18n.mjs). Each entry: { file (repo-relative), kind, contains (substring of the reported text), reason }. Keep it small: add an entry only when a Turkish literal is legitimately not copy shown to a reader. Tenant data and brand names never contain the guarded characters.

entries.reason: System prompt for the translation model: it quotes the Turkish words member, instructor and session as examples of generic vocabulary. The text is sent to the model, never shown to a reader.
Canned reply of the deterministic fake AI provider used in development and tests; it stands in for a model answer and is not product copy.
